code.description: Optional stable code; derived from name with a numeric collision suffix when omitted.

serviceLineCode.description: Optional canonical service line; an active organization service line is resolved when omitted.

RevenueRecognitionEvent.description: Canonical v1 response. Legacy presentation-only names recognitionDate, contractId, milestoneId, policyVersionId, baseAmountMinor, accountingRoute and sourceEvidenceIds are deprecated and are not rendered by first-party UI.

OrganizationWorkflowPolicy.description: Organization-scoped operating model. NAAI_ERP_SOLOPRENEUR only bootstraps this record when it is missing; this persisted policy is the runtime source of truth.

allow_self_approval.description: Bounded self-approval for controlled mode. Solopreneur owner authority is derived from operating_mode and RBAC instead.

expensesSkipped.description: Zero-total source rows retained in reconciliation but intentionally not materialized as expenses

disposition.description: Whether the supplier party was reused or created.

roleDisposition.description: Whether the explicit supplier role was reused or created.

nextActions.description: Canonical operations available for this unresolved tax item.

category.description: Effective first-line category: persisted dimensions.category, otherwise expenseCategoryCode.

fundingTreatments.description: Distinct effective line treatments: the immutable line snapshot, otherwise the reviewed category treatment.

companyOwesOwnerMinor.description: Primary nonnegative dashboard metric for Công ty đang nợ chủ.

ownerHoldsCompanyFundsMinor.description: Nonnegative opposite settlement position; never inferred by the web client.

statutoryOwnerCurrentBalanceMinor.description: Statutory Owner Current control retained for drill-down, not used as the dashboard payable metric.

OwnerSettlementReviewItem.description: Unsupported or unresolved movement. It does not participate in confirmedSettlementBalanceMinor.

statutoryOwnerCurrentBalanceMinor.description: Complete signed balance from the approved statutory Owner Current mapping.

confirmedSettlementBalanceMinor.description: Signed confirmed settlement balance before nonnegative presentation clamps.

supplierTaxId.description: Vietnamese supplier tax ID; punctuation is normalized and the resulting value must contain 10 or 13 digits.

category.description: Optional active organization expense-category code or human-readable OCR label. Exact code/name matches win; similar labels are accepted only when one strong unique match exists.

dueDate.description: Must be on or after documentDate.

fundingSource.description: Legacy alias for an explicit company funding account. Purchase invoices with this active same-currency source credit its server-resolved ledger account and become paid atomically.

funding.description: Canonical funding choice. If omitted for a purchase invoice, the API defaults to owner_paid and credits the approved TT133 owner_current account (for example 3388-OWNER). company_bank requires financialAccountId.

migrationSourceExpenseId.description: Controlled purchase-invoice migration link to an exact matching legacy expense; the original posted journal must be reversed through the normal journal API before replacement posting.

migrationSourceExpenseDate.description: Required together with migrationSourceExpenseId and matched exactly against the legacy expense.

lines.description: Each line or allocation may carry dimensions.projectId and optional dimensions.contractId. Sales and credit projects must belong to partyId; every contract must belong to its selected project.

replacement.description: Complete CreateCommercialDocument payload with reviewed projectId and optional contractId allocation dimensions.
